title: Dynamic Optimistic Constrained OCO with Memory via Delay Equivalence
abstract: arXiv:2611.08302v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online Convex Optimization with memory and time-varying constraints (COCO-M) is a recently-introduced framework that captures the dynamics of stateful online learning and non-stochastic control with budget constraints. Despite its expressive power, COCO-M remains largely understudied. In this work, we tackle this problem in its full scale, providing an optimistic algorithm that incorporates untrusted predictions to tame universal dynamic regret and cumulative constraint violation. Our analysis leverages a potent reduction from memory to delay and treats state-dependent gradients as delayed feedback. We establish the first bounds that adapt to both environment non-stationarity (path length $P_T$) and prediction accuracy, while lifting previous restrictive assumptions such as functional separability. translated_title: 基于延迟等价的动态乐观记忆约束在线凸优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.08302v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：带记忆和时变约束的在线凸优化（COCO-M）是最近提出的一个框架，用于刻画带预算约束的有状态在线学习和非随机控制中的动态特性。尽管COCO-M具有很强的表达能力，但其研究仍然严重不足。在这项工作中，我们全面地解决了这一问题，提供了一种乐观算法，该算法融合了不可信的预测来控制通用动态遗憾和累积约束违反。我们的分析利用了从记忆到延迟的有力归约，并将状态相关的梯度视为延迟反馈。我们建立了首个能够同时适应环境非平稳性（路径长度 $P_T$）和预测准确性的界，同时去除了先前诸如函数可分离性等限制性假设。在获得这些结果的过程中，我们还推导出了一些具有独立价值的发现，涉及记忆到延迟的归约以及带时变约束的延迟OCO。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合不可信预测的乐观算法，通过将记忆归约为延迟来求解带记忆和时变约束的在线凸优化（COCO-M），首次建立了同时适应环境非平稳性与预测准确性的动态遗憾和累积约束违反界，并去除了函数可分离性等限制性假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimistic algorithm incorporating untrusted predictions for COCO-M via a memory-to-delay reduction, establishing the first bounds for dynamic regret and cumulative constraint violation that adapt to both environment non-stationarity and prediction accuracy, while removing restrictive assumptions such as functional separability.
